title: Conversations
subtitle: Think it through, together
emptyTitle: What shall we work on today?
emptyHint: Choose a workbench and start a conversation. Its memory and effective methods come with you.
placeholder: Ask a question, share an idea, or work with a partner…
quickHint: Only a working folder is needed. The workbench name comes from the folder.
networkHint: Models are managed in Settings. Select a configured network here.
nativeNetwork: Uses the partner's native engine configuration
subagentsHint: Delegate tasks with the current partner and permissions
agentBrowserHint: Use an isolated local browser to test pages; no extra API key
safetyNetHint: Block destructive commands and sensitive file access
noSkills: No Skills available for this engine
inheritHint: Each turn inherits its workbench's available memory and validated methods. Chat text is not automatically saved as memory or learning evidence.
locked: Workbench locked after the first message
shortcut: Ctrl / ⌘ + Enter to send · Enter for a new line
noChanges: No changed files reported by this conversation
gitUnavailable: Git is unavailable or this working folder is not a repository. Check the folder and installed Git.
interrupted: Interrupted. Check the workspace before trying again.
operationFailed: Git operation did not complete. Check branch state, Git identity and remote authentication.
noDiff: No text diff is available for this selection
browserHint: Enter an HTTP(S) URL. Pages open in an isolated frame; some sites do not allow embedding.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL without credentials
desktopOnly: Workspace files and Git are available in the desktop app
error: This action could not be completed. Please try again.
helpText: Conversations belong to one workbench. Networks, partners, Skills and attachments can be chosen independently. Each sent message keeps its configuration snapshot. Stop preserves partial output; interrupted actions are never replayed automatically.
noNetwork: Configure a model network in Settings to begin

stopBeforeArchive.message: Stop generation before archiving or deleting this conversation.

restoreFirst.message: Restore this conversation before sending another message.

deleteHint.message: Delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone. Workspace files will be kept.

archiveHint: Archived conversations retain their full history. Restore one to continue chatting.
archiveEmpty: No archived conversations. Archive one from the conversation list actions.
contextTrimmed: Some history omitted from this request
legacyHistoryMissing: Imported history has no complete private tool transcript.
thinkingSummaryTruncated: Part of the summary was omitted
